title: pi-bouncer config
description: The user config (bouncer.json in the Pi agent dir) or a project config (.pi/extensions/bouncer/config.json). A project config reads only levels.

levels.description: The level of a built-in rule: ask or deny.

rm-root.description: recursive rm of the filesystem root, a system directory or your home directory. Built-in level: deny.

recursive-rm.description: recursive rm deletes whole directory trees. Built-in level: ask.

find-delete.description: find -delete deletes every file it matches. Built-in level: ask.

find-exec.description: find -exec, -execdir, -ok and -okdir run arbitrary commands. Built-in level: ask.

fd-exec.description: fd -x and -X run arbitrary commands. Built-in level: ask.

rg-pre.description: rg --pre runs an arbitrary preprocessor command. Built-in level: ask.

opaque-exec.description: parallel, rush and rust-parallel run commands built from templates, so what runs cannot be judged. Built-in level: ask.

disk-format.description: formatting, erasing or repartitioning a disk destroys its data. Built-in level: deny.

dd-device.description: dd writing to a /dev path overwrites a raw device. Built-in level: deny.

power.description: shutting down or rebooting takes the user's machine down. Built-in level: deny.

privilege.description: the agent must not run anything with elevated privileges. Built-in level: deny.

git-clean.description: git clean deletes untracked files for good. Built-in level: ask.

git-reset-hard.description: git reset --hard discards uncommitted changes. Built-in level: ask.

git-checkout-discard.description: checking out paths or forcing a checkout discards working-tree changes. Built-in level: ask.

git-restore-worktree.description: git restore of the working tree discards uncommitted changes. Built-in level: ask.

git-stash-destroy.description: git stash drop and clear destroy stashed work. Built-in level: ask.

git-push-force.description: a force or mirror push overwrites history on the remote. Built-in level: ask.

git-push-delete.description: deleting or pruning remote refs destroys branches and tags on the remote. Built-in level: ask.

remote-script.description: a downloaded script fed into a shell or interpreter runs unreviewed code. Built-in level: ask.

publish.description: publishing releases a package publicly, which cannot be undone. Built-in level: ask.

gh-delete.description: deleting a GitHub repository or release destroys it for everyone. Built-in level: ask.

rotateAboveMiB.description: Rotate the log above this size, in MiB.

generations.description: How many rotated logs to keep.

maxAgeDays.description: Delete rotated logs older than this. Absent: never by age.

startMode.description: The mode a session starts in. YOLO mode starts only with pi --yolo or /yolo.

auto.description: Auto mode: a model judges each ask.

models.description: The judge list, in priority order.

alwaysAsk.description: Command prefixes auto mode always asks about.

environment.description: Facts about your environment the judge is told.

firstByProvider.description: The judge to try first when the session model is from this provider. Each value must be in models.

jev.description: A classifier that settles clear cases before the judge list.
